title: The Lantern Soot on Your Sleeve
youtube_title: The Lantern Soot on Your Sleeve | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Owning a mistake is how trust grows back.
summary: At a cottage hallway of hooks, rugs, and boots, Pilar is tangled up with a lantern soot on a sleeve you turned inward and almost hides it. Pilar tells the baker the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
